title: The First Observance
description: A crowned capybara holds tea above the Sacred Cone. The small custodians gather; Bread Operations and the Potassium Division are already at work. The founding visual record of All Hail the Cone.
alt: Crowned astronaut capybara holding a teacup, with a banana, executive pigeon and small robots gathered around a glowing traffic cone among floating islands.

title: The Imperial Seal
description: A ceremonial interpretation of the Cone, crowned and encircled by orbital gold. An official visual study; the crown does not establish ownership of the Cone.
alt: Golden All Hail the Cone lettering beneath a crowned orange cone, surrounded by an orbital halo against black space.

title: An Ordinary Afternoon
description: Tea aboard a drifting drawing room, a weather vendor open for business, and an entirely routine observance at the Cone. A panorama of civic life between dimensions.
alt: Wide cosmic landscape with a capybara and armoured traveller drinking tea on a floating sofa, an octopus DJ, a working banana, a suited pigeon and robots tending a cone.

title: Possible Tomorrows
description: A contact sheet of possible expeditions, departments, ceremonies and quiet evenings. These are development directions, not evidence that every pictured event has occurred.
alt: Contact sheet showing capybara expeditions, potassium technology, Bread Operations, a robot embracing a cone, cosmic whales and monumental cone architecture.

title: The Kindness Drift
description: A daylight view of the archipelago: bottled weather, spoon orchestras, a portal to an ocean city, and a very large ceremonial duck. Hospitality survives the crossing.
alt: Floating islands beneath a bright sky, with a giant crowned duck, astronaut capybara sharing tea with an armoured traveller, underwater Gate, octopus orchestra and Sacred Cone sanctuary.

title: The Two Pillars
description: An identity board bringing together the violet and amber palette, ceremonial typography, orbital motifs and the Cone mark.
alt: An identity board bringing together the violet and amber palette, ceremonial typography, orbital motifs and the Cone mark.

title: One Symbol, Many Horizons
description: Horizontal logo studies, including compact navigation marks and formal wordmark arrangements.
alt: Horizontal logo studies, including compact navigation marks and formal wordmark arrangements.

title: Higher Ground
description: Vertical and stacked seals, with orbital geometry, crescents and a guiding star.
alt: Vertical and stacked seals, with orbital geometry, crescents and a guiding star.

title: Small Signs, Greater Meaning
description: An icon family exploring app marks, avatars, favicons and embossed ceremonial badges.
alt: An icon family exploring app marks, avatars, favicons and embossed ceremonial badges.

title: One Colour, All Meaning
description: Monochrome and line-art studies testing the identity across paper, dark fields and physical materials.
alt: Monochrome and line-art studies testing the identity across paper, dark fields and physical materials.

title: The Digital Sanctuary
description: A cinematic website concept placing the Cone above a monumental stairway in an inhabited cosmic landscape.
alt: A cinematic website concept placing the Cone above a monumental stairway in an inhabited cosmic landscape.

title: Across Every Screen
description: A digital experience study for desktop, tablet and mobile, with celestial imagery and a consistent ceremonial mark.
alt: A digital experience study for desktop, tablet and mobile, with celestial imagery and a consistent ceremonial mark.

title: Objects of Belonging
description: Explorations of posters, stationery, garments and everyday objects bearing the identity. These are visual concepts, not products offered for sale.
alt: Explorations of posters, stationery, garments and everyday objects bearing the identity. These are visual concepts, not products offered for sale.

title: The Violet Imperial Crest
description: An ornate crowned Cone in amber and violet, surrounded by radiant geometry, crescents and the All Hail the Cone wordmark.
alt: An ornate crowned Cone in amber and violet, surrounded by radiant geometry, crescents and the All Hail the Cone wordmark.

title: The Horizon Lockup
description: A wide ceremonial signature pairing the violet-and-amber Cone with the words Higher Ground Awaits.
alt: A wide ceremonial signature pairing the violet-and-amber Cone with the words Higher Ground Awaits.

title: The Radiant Lockup
description: A horizontal identity with a star-topped cone, an orbital halo and a golden wordmark.
alt: A horizontal identity with a star-topped cone, an orbital halo and a golden wordmark.

title: The Crescent Seal
description: A formal violet-and-amber seal set within a pointed orbital frame, with a crown, crescent moons and a guiding star.
alt: A formal violet-and-amber seal set within a pointed orbital frame, with a crown, crescent moons and a guiding star.

title: The Sacred Signal
description: An isolated violet-and-amber Cone with a luminous orbit and a star above its tip. A ceremonial interpretation of the founding object.
alt: An isolated violet-and-amber Cone with a luminous orbit and a star above its tip. A ceremonial interpretation of the founding object.

title: The Stellar Wordmark
description: A dimensional gold and violet wordmark with bright star details. Lettering is preserved as supplied.
alt: A dimensional gold and violet wordmark with bright star details. Lettering is preserved as supplied.

title: The Crowned Amber Cone
description: A crowned orange-and-white Cone with a golden orbital halo and violet jewel details.
alt: A crowned orange-and-white Cone with a golden orbital halo and violet jewel details.

title: The White Archive Seal
description: A textured white variation of the ornate archive seal. The supplied distressed transparency is retained.
alt: A textured white variation of the ornate archive seal. The supplied distressed transparency is retained.

title: The Violet Reliquary
description: A luminous violet Cone framed by ornamental flourishes, a crown and an orbital ring.
alt: A luminous violet Cone framed by ornamental flourishes, a crown and an orbital ring.

title: The Founding Colours
description: An ornate horizontal signature featuring the orange-and-white Cone, a crown and golden All Hail the Cone lettering.
alt: An ornate horizontal signature featuring the orange-and-white Cone, a crown and golden All Hail the Cone lettering.

title: The First Observer
description: A formal portrait from an archive that cannot agree on when it was taken. The black mug, violet-lined coat and Cone pendant recur in every reliable account.
alt: The First Observer in a dark violet-lined coat, holding a notebook in a celestial archive.

title: The Silent Origin
description: An archival study of the Observer against an orbital record. It establishes neither his age nor his relationship to the first crossing.
alt: The First Observer framed by a gold orbital diagram and violet nebulae.

title: The Observer in Full
description: A silhouette record: dark travelling coat, violet astronomical scarf, black mug and notebook. Personal objects, not instruments of command.
alt: Full-length portrait of The First Observer wearing a dark coat with violet and amber details, holding a black mug and notebook.

title: The Uncharted Observatory
description: A temporary archive of instruments, overlapping maps and difficult windows. The black cat remains unlisted by choice, not by cosmic necessity.
alt: The First Observer and a black cat beside a desk in an observatory, with a vast dark Cone visible through arched windows.

title: The First Ground, Revisited
description: A broad record of the Observer looking over the connected territories. A monumental Cone marks the horizon; the scene does not establish a second Sacred Cone.
alt: The First Observer on a balcony with a mug and notebook, looking over floating cities and a distant monumental Cone.

title: A Field Note in Violet
description: An isolated record prepared for the archive: observer, cup and notebook. The book contains gathered testimony, never automatic answers.
alt: Isolated full-length image of The First Observer holding a mug and a black notebook, wearing a violet-lined coat.

title: The Margin at Dusk
description: A route-side observation near sunset. The archive treats the landscape as a possibility, not evidence that every threshold has been crossed.
alt: The First Observer holding a black mug at dusk before floating islands, golden architecture and a dark orbital Cone.

title: The Balcony of Unwritten Routes
description: The Observer at the edge of a maintained city, watching roads the archive has not yet learned to name.
alt: The First Observer in a violet-lined coat holding a notebook on a balcony above floating territories and a dark Cone.
